name: Brahim BIDI
subName: JavaScript & Deno Architect | AI & Automation Systems
aboutMe:
Hello! I'm Ibrahim Bidi, a Senior JavaScript & Deno Architect, AI Systems Engineer, and Automation Specialist with 22+ years of hands-on software development experience. From V8 engine internals to distributed microservices, autonomous AI agents, algorithmic trading bots, and real-time WebSocket platforms, JavaScript and TypeScript are my core domain.

Over the past two decades, I have architected high-concurrency systems, contributed extensively to open-source, and launched live platforms spanning autonomous AI trading platforms (Ghosn Pro AI), prompt engineering engines (Vibe Note), AI music streaming (SunoMA), multi-account messaging automation (WMAM), AI developer browsers (NIABrowser), and algorithmic trading systems. My journey started with pioneering system tools for Windows 98/XP (Key4Arab, Tifino) and evolved into architecting scalable modern web apps, cloud runtimes, and autonomous agent infrastructure.

items.name: Ghosn Pro AI — Autonomous Crypto Algorithmic Trading Platform & MCP Agent

events.text: Ghosn Pro AI (ai.ghosn.pro): Autonomous algorithmic cryptocurrency trading platform supporting Binance Spot & Futures with sub-millisecond (<1.2ms) real-time indicator computation and custom DSL trading strategies.

Universal AI Agent Ecosystem: Full Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration, developer SKILL.md, and OAuth 2.0 connecting Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, and Gemini to live market data and automated order execution.

Cumulative Long-Term Memory (AI Memory): Persistent strategy knowledge base, multi-target profit/trailing stop-loss automation, Binance Testnet integration with 15k USDT virtual balance, and real-time Telegram/Webhook alerts.

items.name: Vibe Note — AI Prompt Bank & Dynamic Variable Engine

Vibe Note on Google Play Store: Official Android mobile app for discovering curated AI prompts, customizing dynamic variables on the fly, and cross-device prompt management.
